cities.name: Sydney, Australia
cities.description: A vibrant city known for its iconic Sydney Opera House, Harbour Bridge, and stunning coastal beaches like Bondi.

cities.name: Melbourne, Australia
cities.description: A cultural hub celebrated for its rich arts scene, world-class coffee culture, historic laneways, and lively festivals.

cities.name: Tokyo, Japan
cities.description: A dazzling metropolis blending ultra-modern skyscrapers and neon lights with historic temples and exquisite cuisine.

cities.name: Kyoto, Japan
cities.description: Famous for its thousands of classical Buddhist temples, gardens, imperial palaces, traditional wooden houses, and cherry blossoms.

cities.name: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
cities.description: A famed coastal city renowned for its breathtaking landscapes, Christ the Redeemer statue, and vibrant Carnival culture.

cities.name: São Paulo, Brazil
cities.description: South America's largest metropolis, packed with rich cultural institutions, legendary gastronomic scenes, and bustling commerce.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: A majestic UNESCO World Heritage complex and the largest religious monument in the world, filled with intricate stone carvings.

temples.name: Taj Mahal, India
temples.description: An immense ivory-white marble mausoleum on the Yamuna river bank, globally acclaimed as a masterpiece of Mughal architecture.

beaches.name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
beaches.description: A tropical paradise featuring turquoise lagoons, coral reefs, overwater luxury bungalows, and dormant volcanic peaks.

beaches.name: Copacabana Beach, Brazil
beaches.description: One of the most famous 4-kilometer crescent beaches in the world, alive with sunbathers, promenade kiosks, and beach sports.
